scope: Port two lifecycle observers to Coax on the same frozen historical producers, package and current host epoch. Stable ownership, validation, browser, status and all shared original served-source observations agree. No producer or shader was emitted for this port.

compiler.provenance: Previously retained qualified historical compiler, explicitly selected through COAX. Not a current-main compiler or product-emission qualification. A copy of this exact compiler is retained under executed-tools/compiler.

executed_images.note: Every actual observer image was copied into its case directory immediately after execution. Later cache recompilation is not substituted for an earlier executed image.

fixture_origins.historical_context: historical-marker/ retains the earlier fixture receipts and marker source as historical provenance, not newly executed code.

host_epoch.fresh_legacy_observations: The five legacy baselines were run once on this current host epoch, because the older retained host/render epoch differs. Those passing observations were reused for the final Coax comparisons.

lifecycle.dependency_epoch: Origin later gained separately qualified POST framing and stale-preflight checks; lifecycle decision procedures and their checks were unchanged.

parity_family.scope: Focused receipt-family test only; no full authority execution-coverage claim for this nonauthority observation tool.

retained_earlier_attempts.coax-before: Passed preliminary v1 diagnostic epoch; not the final v2 qualification.
retained_earlier_attempts.coax-during: Retained harness failure: all physical observations were present, but undefined renderSettled() had been confused with missing CDP value. The fixed observer carries {defined,value} and omits validation only when actually undefined, matching legacy.
retained_earlier_attempts.coax-during-v2: Passed explicit undefined handling and v2 diagnostics before later origin framing/preflight safeguards.
retained_earlier_attempts.coax-before-final/coax-during-final/coax: Passed v2 and legacy POST404 framing before final stale-output preflight guard.
retained_earlier_attempts.origin-foundation-earlier-epoch: Passing real-loopback sequence/variant/hash/finalization control from an earlier origin epoch. Final actual browser cases qualify the final origin; this older pass is not silently rebound to the final source.
retained_earlier_attempts.policy_red_and_mutation_logs: Earlier failures and survivors are retained in checks. No mutant was waived or declared equivalent.

observer_boundaries.window_events: Actual window error and unhandledrejection observations, named separately from legacy raw CDP event objects.
observer_boundaries.unretained_raw_events: The current Coax CDP client counts but does not retain the full execution-context, console and exception event objects. Archived v1 raw diagnostics remain intact. No raw diagnostic-array or schema identity claim.
observer_boundaries.chrome_profile_difference: Both profiles are headless, audio-muted WebGPU. The Coax launcher lacks the legacy --disable-background-timer-throttling and --disable-renderer-backgrounding flags. Explicit clip steps and controlled release points preserve these scoped lifecycle observations; no Chrome argv identity or performance parity claim.
observer_boundaries.deadlines: 810s whole observer, 840s origin, 120s per CDP request and replacement completion, 60s warmup/held boundaries, 10s media completion, 5s socket operations; all actual final commands completed in seconds.
observer_boundaries.origin_capabilities: Finalized source-fenced loopback GET fixtures, deterministic response sequences and explicit one-site variants. POST bodies are bounded and completely drained before the legacy 404 refusal. Version1 has no accepted POST sinks or arbitrary URL-to-write mapping.
